the operationalization of a frailty index from routine laboratory tests.
the operationalization of a frailty index based on routine laboratory and urine test data, and its validation in a prospective cohort study.
the operationalization of an FI from routine blood parameters and a standard urine test.

the FI-Lab has potential for use as an uncomplicated frailty instrument in busy clinical settings.
